name: azure-devops
description: Operate Azure DevOps through the Azure CLI's azure-devops extension: projects, teams, Git repositories, pull requests, pipelines and runs, work items and queries, wikis, universal packages and variable groups. Runs a strict preflight gate (az CLI present, azure-devops extension installed, session authenticated) and stops with a clear message on failure - it never logs in or installs anything, and it exposes no non-DevOps Azure features.
